items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: "The new personnel was given as: Syd Valentine, Red Harland, Sprat Morton, playing trumpets." ... "I suspect that Jack Spratt, who was listed as one of your trumpets, along with Roy Eldridge and Red Harland"

ctx.x: Okay. Then it says B. Morton, trombone. That probably was Benny Morton -- not Benny Morton.
